title: Long-Range Larceny
setup: Your bishop on c4 looks up its light diagonal and finds a black rook standing on it.
hint: Follow the diagonal from c4: d5, e6... what's on the next square?
explanation:
## The Idea

The bishop's diagonal from c4 runs d5, e6, f7, and the black rook on f7 stands right in its path with **nobody guarding it**. The black king on a8 is far too distant to help.

{{Bxf7}} travels the whole line in one move and takes the rook for free.

Bishops strike from across the board. Trace each diagonal to its end before you decide nothing is loose.
